preserve_product_clause: The product itself remains completely still and unchanged in every frame: its exact shape, proportions, color, material, texture, logos and printed text stay identical, with no morphing, warping or distortion. Stable camera, photorealistic advertisement cinematography, consistent composition throughout.
note_cfg1_negative_prompt_vo_dung: Da kiem chung qua job test (negative_co_tac_dung: false khi cfg=1.0). Moi rang buoc 'giu nguyen san pham' PHAI nam trong chuyen_dong (positive), khong dua vao negative_prompt.
image_prompt_skeleton: In image 1, the {OLD_PRODUCT_DESC} is completely removed, including its {OLD_PRODUCT_PARTS}, reflections and shadow, and nothing of its shape remains. In its place, the product from image 2 stands as the central hero product {SCENE_POSITION_DESC}, in the same position and at the same scale, resting/standing exactly as the original product did. The product keeps its own shape and proportions from image 2 and does not take the shape of the {OLD_PRODUCT_SHORT}. {PRESENTATION} Keep the exact design of the product from image 2, including its shape, color, material, texture and every detail, with only the text and logos that are printed on it in image 2; no lettering or markings from image 1 appear on it. Keep the {SCENE_ELEMENTS}, the lighting and the composition exactly the same as image 1. {EFFECT_CONTINUATION_DESC}. Do not add any detail that is not in image 1 or image 2.
image_prompt_skeleton_note: Dung cho prompt accessory_flux_lab (anh tinh, khong lien quan video). Dien tung {THE_NAY} theo dung noi dung base.png cua template -- KHONG nhac mau/hieu ung chi xuat hien o khung SAU trong video (vd neon doi mau) neu ban than base.png chua co, vi day la anh tinh duoc dung lam goc cho ca anh lan video.
note_base_frame_tim_qua_wipe: Nhieu video mau co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) o dau (~frame 15-25/129, 24fps), phai do tim khung SAU khi quet xong (bo cuc day du, khong con vet quet, chua co hieu ung mau phu them) de lam base.png -- KHONG mac dinh lay frame 0.
note_dan_lai_phai_tat: QUAN TRONG: goi /generate/accessory_flux_lab PHAI luon gui 'dan_lai': false.
